method.purpose: Review priority only; no label edits, coordinate proposals, model predictions, or white-pixel threshold.
method.tangent: Left-to-right line between two locatable saved corners; horizontal fallback when only one is locatable.
method.score: max(0, median(inward/up patch) - median(saved-point patch)), in grayscale levels
method.border_policy: Require both full 3x3 patches. Otherwise record the endpoint as unscored; do not pad or infer pixels.
method.sort: Score descending, then image_id, current one-based row, side alphabetical
method.limitation: A valid material corner is often darker than the face. Brightness, curvature, shadows, blur, and occlusion can make false flags. The score is not a probability or an annotation-accuracy measure.

additional_review_selection.rule: Top 8 scored eligible endpoints on distinct new-series photos; skip protected rows, held/excluded photos and all currently reviewed photos. No manual replacement of selected cases.
